content: Yehoba Gamagalau Analiya I Pasamwayagayaga
Valila gamagalau gegewel panayawiya analiya maisena ya ge wali baaba i maisena.
He gamagalau hi mimi heheya labi balimana, inoke abwab bwabwatana etega hi pwawa labi Babiloniya elana yaka hi minaa to.
Yaka abwe hi pebaaba-agil hi ba, “Ehei! Bilibili ta ahe bilik ta ginolil yaka ta tonil ge nihi gasisi.” Inoke hi ginol ola to, yaka bilik hi ahe limi hi taliya, ge kolta
hi ahe bilik hi papihikagil.

Yaka abwe hi ba, “Ehei! Wala panuwa bwabwatana etega ta ginol ge limi mihahaina hot etegana ta tal ni na ni tupa yaluyaluwa. Ta ginol ola o, inoke alala ni bwata ge bahi ta mimiwaliwali panayawi labena gegewena elal.”
Yaa Yehoba i nem i lau panuwa bwabwatana ge limi mihahaina hot toto gamagalau hi taltal o i kitel.

Inoke i ba, “Gamagalau ya heliya boda maisena ge anan maisena elana hi baaba. Sauga ya bugul ya hi giginol, he bwaliga abwe bugul ni gewi al nihi ginolil. Ebo bugul etega nihi nuwatuan, he bosowailiya ya te nihi awaawaginol ya.
Ehei! Ta na ta lau analiya ta pasamwayagayaga inoke bahi avaliyau wali baaba ana sapu nihi aatena.”
Inoke eliyana Yehoba gamagalau i waliwali-agil hi na panayawi labena gegewena elal, yaka panuwa o nige al hi tatal.
Inoke panuwa alana hi tun Babiloni
kaiwena panuwa o elana Yehoba gamagalau gegewel analiya i pasamwayagayaga, yaka eliyana i waliwali-agil panayawi labena gegewena elal.
Semi ge Tubutubunau Liwaniliya
Semi alonau natunau ge tubutubunau liwaniliya i ola hiwe. Nub i mowasi enaa baliman eluwana elana, Semi wana baliman 100 yaka natuna i gan alana Alpakad.
Alpakad hi ab enaa, Semi i minamina al baliman 500 yaka natunau bolau ge yowau enuna al hi gan.
Alpakad wana baliman 35 yaka natuna i gan alana Sela.
Sela hi ab enaa, Alpakad i minamina al baliman 403 yaka natunau bolau ge yowau enuna al hi gan.
Sela wana baliman 30 yaka natuna i gan alana Ebe.
Ebe hi ab enaa, Sela i minamina al baliman 403 yaka natunau bolau ge yowau enuna al hi gan.
Ebe wana baliman 34 yaka natuna i gan alana Peleg.
Peleg hi ab enaa, Ebe i minamina al baliman 430 yaka natunau bolau ge yowau enuna al hi gan.
Peleg wana baliman 30 yaka natuna i gan alana Liu.
Liu hi ab enaa, Peleg i minamina al baliman 209 yaka natunau bolau ge yowau enuna al hi gan.
Liu wana baliman 32 yaka natuna i gan alana Selag.
Selag hi ab enaa, Liu i minamina al baliman 207 yaka natunau bolau ge yowau enuna al hi gan.
Selag wana baliman 30 yaka natuna i gan alana Naho.
Naho hi ab enaa, Selag i minamina al baliman 200 yaka natunau bolau ge yowau enuna al hi gan.
Naho wana baliman 29 yaka natuna i gan alana Tela.
Tela hi ab enaa, Naho i minamina al baliman 119 yaka natunau bolau ge yowau enuna al hi gan.
Tela wana baliman 70 yaka natunau hi gan alaliya Abalam, Naho ge Halan.
Tela Alonau Abalam ge Lote Panuwa Ul Hi Eguluwan
He Tela alonau natunau ge tubunau liwaniliya i ola hiwe. Tela natunau hi gan alaliya Abalam, Naho ge Halan. Inoke Halan natuna i gan alana Lote.
He Tela yawalina miminana, natuna Halan i aliga panuwa Ul, labi Koldiya elana, panuwa toto hi aba.
Abalam i alolon lagona alana Selai ge Naho i alolon lagona alana Milika, iya Halan natuna. He Milika talina alana Iska.
Yaa Selai i kobwas yaka nige i aab.

Tela i lut natuna Abalam, tubuna Lote (Halan natuna) ge yawana Selai (Abalam lagona) i ahel, yaka panuwa Ul labi Koldiya elana hi eguluwan ge nihi nok nihi na Kenani. Yaa sauga hi vin panuwa Halani, yaka hi miminaa ga to.
Tela wana baliman 205 i pwawa, yaka i aligaa panuwa Halani.

footnotes.text: Abatelipuna 6:14 ana epwamwananal paiya nu kite.
Pana Hibilu elana alan “Babiloni” ana hago i ola “pasamwayagayaga.”
